results.title: Nintendo is rated "Bad" with 1.3 / 5 on Trustpilot
results.content:
Evaluating 98 reviews, most reviewers were let down by their experience overall. Consumers frequently complain about the expensive pricing across games and accessories, unhelpful customer service representatives, and difficult website navigation systems. People frequently struggle to get proper assistance, clear communication, or fair refunds when facing frustrating technical problems with their d evices. Many buyers feel that the company ignores consumer feedback and implements questionable, profit-driven business practices. Some reviewers were happy with the actual hardware performance and the overall simplicity of purchasing items online. Certain dedicated fans also expressed strong appreciation for specific classic game titles, traditional consoles, and nostalgic brand experiences.See [...] ## I am very disappointed with Nintendo
I am very disappointed with Nintendo. One of the biggest games of the decade, GTA VI, is coming out, and Nintendo users are being left behind because there is no partnership or support to bring the game to the platform.  
  
As a loyal Nintendo customer, this is frustrating. Many players want the freedom to enjoy major third-party releases without having to buy another console. It feels like Nintendo is missing a huge opportunity and ignoring what many fans want.  
  
I know this may not be entirely Nintendo’s decision, but from a customer’s perspective, it’s disappointing that they haven’t made it possible for us to play GTA VI on a Nintendo console. [...] I have sent multiple emails. I have made numerous phone calls. Sent video evidence, screenshots from reviews and tried to escalate this to a complaint but they continue to deny a refund and ask for more evidence. They expect customers to keep broken software indefinitely. This completely violates basic consumer rights regarding faulty digital goods. Their refusal to resolve this is ridiculous. Their support system is designed to exhaust you into giving up.   
  
I have been a life long Nintendo fan and consumer, never had any issues previous that I have had to deal with customer service but this experience has shocked me and left a really bad impression. Disgusting!
